summary: Backend regression for GestaoEPI v5.0.9 with the 5 critical fixes. 17/17 tests passed (100%). Validated: auth (admin login + must_change_password=true returned), employees CRUD with facial_consent true/false persisted, biometric-consent endpoint persists facial_consent + facial_consent_date for both accepted=true and accepted=false, GET biometric-consent returns has_consent/consent_date/consent_ip, biometric/check-duplicate with 128-float zero vector responds 200, delivery creation persists items with quantity=3 and size='M' (verified via GET /api/deliveries), employee PDF report returns application/pdf with Content-Disposition, and smoke checks for /epis /companies /kits /employees /dashboard/stats all return 200.

minor.issue: Hard requirement: employee must have photo_path; otherwise 400 'Colaborador não possui foto cadastrada'. Seed employee João da Silva has no photo, so any test/UI using only seed data without first uploading a photo will fail. Test suite handled by uploading a 1x1 PNG via POST /api/employees/{id}/photo before creating a delivery.

action_items: Optional: seed João da Silva with a placeholder photo_path so UI delivery flow demos work out-of-the-box without forcing a photo upload step.
Consider relaxing the 'employee must have photo' rule for is_return=true (returns shouldn't really need a fresh photo).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2244 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; split into routers (employees, deliveries, biometrics, reports).
create_delivery enforces photo_path even for returns (is_return=true), which is overly strict; consider checking only when is_return=False.
biometric/check-duplicate iterates all templates linearly in Python (O(N) per call) — fine for small N but should be flagged for scale > 5k employees.

BIOMETRIC_DUPLICATE_THRESHOLD = 0.40 is hardcoded; the user-stated facial recognition threshold change to 0.50 + margin 0.06 lives only in the frontend (EntregaEPI.js) — no backend assertion enforces it. Acceptable since recognition is client-side via face-api.js, but document this.

seed_data_creation: Tests create temporary employees prefixed TEST_ and delete them in teardown. A temporary EPI (TEST_EPI_*) is created if no existing EPI with size+stock is found.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_backend_v509.py as regression suite. All 5 v5.0.9 fixes verified at API level. For UI testing, focus on: (1) EntregaEPI.js facial threshold UX, (2) grouped size dropdown with optgroup variants, (3) per-item quantity input with stock validation, (4) consent radio Aceito/Não aceito blocking biometry on refusal, (5) employee detail page biometry status banner + PDF row. Backend is 100% green so any UI failures are frontend-only.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The two requested critical persistence behaviors — (a) accepted=false stores facial_consent=false WITH facial_consent_date, and (b) deliveries persist size + quantity per item — both work correctly end-to-end (verified via GET round-trip).
